ModMetaData.name: Goal Planner
ModMetaData.author: comdobby
ModMetaData.description:
Set goals and see everything you need to reach them: prerequisite research, buildings and workbenches, and resources. Plan ahead and stockpile materials before you start building.
목표를 설정하면 필요한 선행 연구, 건물과 작업대, 자원을 한눈에 보여주는 모드입니다.
